entities.summary: Count Gavriil (Gavrila) Ivanovich Golovkin was a Russian statesman who formally presided over Russian foreign affairs from 1706 until his death. Real control during his lengthy term in office was exercised by Boris Kurakin until 1727 and by Andrey Osterman after his death.
